verdict.rationale: Mercury auto-matches receipts to the right card transaction, but only after the user emails or uploads them, so capture is not automatic at the moment of the swipe. Coding is possible through categories, transaction-metadata and categorization write actions, plus AI accounting automations. Transaction webhooks, attachment upload and a receipt-upload agent skill would let an AI-native user build the rest of the workflow themselves. Missing for 10: automatic receipt capture triggered by card use (no emailing or uploading), documented automatic coding of transactions at the time of spend, and independent hands-on corroboration.
